{{Quote|It's not my fault half my entertainers on Ralltiir are being rounded up as Rebel sympathizers, Governor Snopps on Corulag won't tell those Academy cadets to stop abusing my pleasure hall girls, and the Esselian government wants to cut out the union and regulate the industry there in its own tyrannical fashion.|Mayli Weng, representative of the Exotic Entertainers' Union, complains about Governor Snopps|<ref name="Old Flame">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
The '''Exotic Entertainers' Union''' was an organization of exotic dancers on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Its function was provide licenses and protecting its members's rights from criminal syndicates or governmental unjust regulations. Improvement of working conditions and protection of its members, the Union's several representatives engaged in political maneuvering, contact with entertainment professionals, lobbying business moguls, and gaining favor within the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]].<ref name="sotes" />

The Union had several representatives; [[Mayli Weng]] represented 20,000 artists who worked in high-class [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]-based establishments, but also itirenary entertainers who moved between clubs and [[restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]s throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Weng kept ties with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], as many of these [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[pleasure house]]s were operated by [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] as fronts for Black Sun. Thanks to Wang, the [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] and Black Sun [[Underlord]], pressed several times the [[Entertainment Owners' League]] into making concessions to the Union.<ref name="sotes" />
